subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Identificar, em texto dramático, personagem, ato, cena, fala e indicações cênicas e a organização do texto: enredo, conflitos, ideias principais, pontos de vista, universos de referência.

components.description_pt: Identificar elementos estruturais do drama como diálogo, indicações cênicas e elenco
components.description_en: Identify structural elements of drama such as dialogue, stage directions, and cast of characters
components.cc_component_description: Identify structural elements of drama such as dialogue, stage directions, and cast of characters

components.description_pt: Analisar enredo e conflitos desenvolvidos através de atos e cenas em texto dramático
components.description_en: Analyze the plot and conflicts developed across acts and scenes in a dramatic text
components.cc_component_description: Explain how scenes in a drama work together to build the drama's overall structure

components.description_pt: Identificar ideias principais, pontos de vista e marcos de referência presentes em texto dramático
components.description_en: Identify main ideas, points of view, and frames of reference present in a dramatic text
components.cc_component_description: Compare contrasting points of view between two or more characters or narrators in a text

cc_matches.description: Explain major differences between poems, drama, and prose, and refer to the structural elements of poems (e.g., verse, rhythm, meter) and drama (e.g., casts of characters, settings, descriptions, dialogue, stage directions) when writing or speaking about a text.
Explain how a series of chapters, scenes, or stanzas fits together to provide the overall structure of a particular story, drama, or poem.
Analyze how an author develops and contrasts the points of view of different characters or narrators in a text.
